RECEIPT.prompt_description: A document confirming a completed payment, charge, or money transfer. Examples: store receipts, payment confirmations, Interac e-Transfer confirmations, ATM receipts, bank transfer records, money transfer screenshots.

INVOICE.prompt_description: A bill or notice showing an amount owed that has NOT been charged or paid yet. Examples: utility bills, tax bills, property tax notices, insurance statements, subscription invoices with a due date.

ORDER_CONFIRMATION.prompt_description: An order acknowledgment or shipping notification. Examples: online order confirmations, delivery notifications, booking confirmations.

SHIPPING_CONFIRMATION.prompt_description: A shipping confirmation or tracking update. Examples: shipping confirmation, out for delivery, package delivered.

NOT_RECEIPT.prompt_description: Anything that is not a financial document. Examples: newsletters, advertisements, general correspondence, account statements with no actionable amount.
